title: RNAseK is vital for epithelial proton pump activity in Drosophila melanogaster
authors: Maurya C; Gillen AD; Keenan S; Dow JA
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇RNAseK对V-ATPase质子泵活性的影响，属上皮运输功能与表型分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The transporting epithelial tissues comprising the Drosophila melanogaster alimentary and renal systems are known to share a common set of enriched genes sometimes referred to as the "epitheliome", reflecting their shared transport functions. Core amongst these genes are the vha genes, which encode subunits of the large Vacuolar-type ATPase (V-ATPase) proton pump complex. However, many of the non-vha components of the epitheliome remain broadly uncharacterised. Here, we explore the role of RNAseK, a gene identified during unbiased epithelial screens in Drosophila whose function within insects is not yet known, though evidence from mammalian systems suggest a role in supporting proton pump activity. We demonstrate computationally that RNAseK is strongly conserved across evolutionary history, and that expression is regulated by the highly epithelial-specific dCLEAR motif. Seeking to understand why epithelial expression is so emphasised, we have assayed the effects of RNAseK knockdown in different epithelia throughout the fly. Across hindgut, midgut, and Malpighian tubules, we note profound defects in gross tissue morphology, transport activity, and fly survival. Mechanistically, our findings that RNAseK may co-localise with the V-ATPase complex, and that V-ATPase inhibition phenocopies RNAseK knockdown, suggest that RNAseK is a critical component of the proton transport axis across Drosophila tissues.
abstract_zh: 包含果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）消化系统和肾系统的运输上皮组织已知共享一组富集基因，有时被称为“上皮组”（epitheliome），反映其共同的运输功能。这些基因中的核心是vha基因，其编码大型液泡型ATPase（V-ATPase）质子泵复合物的亚基。然而，上皮组中的许多非vha组分仍未得到广泛表征。在此，我们探讨了RNAseK的作用，该基因是在果蝇无偏上皮筛选中鉴定出的，其在昆虫中的功能尚不清楚，尽管来自哺乳动物系统的证据表明其在支持质子泵活性中发挥作用。我们通过计算证明，RNAseK在进化历史上高度保守，其表达受高度上皮特异性的dCLEAR基序调控。为探究上皮表达为何如此突出，我们检测了RNAseK敲低在果蝇不同上皮中的效应。在后肠、中肠和马氏管中，我们观察到组织形态、运输活性和果蝇存活方面的显著缺陷。在机制上，我们发现RNAseK可能与V-ATPase复合物共定位，且V-ATPase抑制能表型复制RNAseK敲低效应，这表明RNAseK是果蝇组织中质子运输轴的关键组分。
